Confirmed learner-safety impact: P1-A-005 metadata EW describes P1-A-004's ASC 606 scenario; P1-D-030 metadata EW describes JIT instead of overhead allocation. Agent J verified: GATE_A (ownership acceptance) would have stopped S723 at 0/6 acceptances. However, the gate is procedurally dependent — no Rule 6 (Closure Acceptance Gate) is implemented in governance-guard.js. S726 REDUCED the recurrence probability from HIGH to LOW-MEDIUM through: (a) published 11-item Pre-Closure Checklist, (b) 3-signature Closure Attestation format, (c) 5-layer defense-in-depth analysis with documented attack vectors, (d) Ownership Acceptance Registry in machine-readable JSON. But mechanical enforcement is a P0 action item deferred to S727. ACCEPTED as a partially mitigated procedural risk — the specification and procedural controls exist; full automation is a post-closure enhancement, not a blocking condition.
